task.summary: Replace the hand-curated CITY_AREA map as the primary lookup with generated, exhaustive coverage of all ~1,300 Israeli settlements (city / moshav / kibbutz / community settlement / village), resolved to the app's five business areas. Additionally emit a sub-area layer (גוש דן, השרון, שפלה, ...) as metadata for future within-area route clustering. Build-time generation only — zero runtime network calls, zero new runtime dependencies.

architecture_decision.tier-1: The existing union 'צפון' | 'מרכז' | 'שומרון' | 'ירושלים' | 'דרום'. Drives scheduling, UI sections, and day-planning. UNCHANGED — five zones map to workday-sized territories from the technicians' base (אבני חפץ).
architecture_decision.tier-2: Finer geographic region (גוש דן, השרון, לב השרון, שפלה, עמק חפר, עמק יזרעאל, הגליל, הכרמל, הנגב, ...). Consumed in a later phase for within-area job sorting / route clustering. NOT part of the scheduling contract in this task.
architecture_decision.rationale: Splitting the operational level into 10-15 fine regions would fragment day-planning for a two-technician team; keeping Area stable also avoids touching AREA_ORDER, AreaOrUnassigned, and every component that renders area sections. The CBS source carries נפה/מועצה אזורית anyway, so tier-2 is free to capture now and cheap to activate later.
architecture_decision.resolution_order: 1. CITY_AREA (manual business overrides — e.g. מודיעין → 'ירושלים') 2. SETTLEMENT_AREA (generated, CBS-derived) 3. UNASSIGNED_AREA (existing fallback bucket)

data_source.primary: data.gov.il dataset "citiesandsettelments" (רשימת ישובים בישראל), CKAN datastore API: GET https://data.gov.il/api/3/action/datastore_search with resource_id discovered from https://data.gov.il/dataset/citiesandsettelments (prefer the English-headers resource). Paginate via limit/offset until records exhausted; assert total matches result.total.
data_source.fallback: CBS bycode workbook: https://www.cbs.gov.il/he/publications/doclib/2019/ishuvim/bycode2021.xlsx (use the newest year available). Only if the datastore API is unreachable.
data_source.fields: settlement name (Hebrew), settlement code (סמל יישוב), district (מחוז), sub-district (נפה), regional council (מועצה אזורית), municipal status.
data_source.provenance: Commit the raw snapshot (scripts/data/settlements.json) with a fetched-at timestamp and source URL in a sibling metadata block, so generation is reproducible offline and diffs are reviewable.

deliverables.file: Node ≥20, native fetch, no new deps. Paginated download of the full settlement list → scripts/data/settlements.json (pretty-printed, stable key order so git diffs stay minimal). Fail loudly on schema drift: validate expected field names on the first page before proceeding.

file.mapping: מחוז הצפון, מחוז חיפה → 'צפון' מחוז תל אביב, מחוז המרכז → 'מרכז' אזור יהודה והשומרון → 'שומרון' מחוז ירושלים → 'ירושלים' מחוז הדרום → 'דרום'

Lookup table, most-specific wins (regional council before נפה): נפת תל אביב → 'גוש דן' נפת פתח תקווה, נפת רמלה, נפת רחובות → 'שפלה ומרכז' נפת השרון; מ.א. לב השרון, עמק חפר, חוף השרון → 'השרון' נפת חיפה, נפת חדרה → 'חוף הכרמל וחדרה' נפות עכו/יזרעאל/צפת/כנרת/גולן → 'גליל ועמקים' נפת ירושלים; מ.א. מטה יהודה → 'הרי ירושלים' נפות אשקלון/באר שבע → 'נגב ודרום' יהודה ושומרון: split by regional council (שומרון/בנימין → 'שומרון'; גוש עציון/הר חברון → 'גוש עציון') Unmapped rows → sub-area omitted (never guessed). Log a summary of unmapped districts/councils at the end of generation.
file.normalization: Single normalizeCityName implementation shared with runtime (see areas.ts step): NFC-normalize, trim, collapse internal whitespace, strip geresh/gershayim variants (׳ ״ ' " `), unify maqaf/hyphen (־ -), drop parenthetical qualifiers — e.g. "נהלל (מושב)" → "נהלל". Emit known spelling variants as duplicate keys (פתח תקווה / פתח תקוה, קרית / קריית). On duplicate settlement names in the source resolving to DIFFERENT areas, fail the build with a report — never pick silently.
file.output: Header: "GENERATED FILE — do not edit. Regenerate: pnpm generate:areas". export const SETTLEMENT_AREA: Record<string, Area> export const SETTLEMENT_SUB_AREA: Record<string, SubArea> export const SUB_AREAS: readonly SubArea[] // render order, north → south export type SubArea = (typeof SUB_AREAS)[number] Keys pre-normalized. Sorted alphabetically for stable diffs.

deliverables.file: 1. Add and export normalizeCityName(name: string): string — identical rules to the generator (keep one canonical implementation; the generator may import it via a small shared module if trivial, otherwise duplicate with a cross-referencing comment + parity test). 2. Area resolution becomes: normalize → CITY_AREA → SETTLEMENT_AREA → UNASSIGNED_AREA. 3. Add getSubArea(city: string): SubArea | undefined (normalize → SETTLEMENT_SUB_AREA). No UI consumes it yet. 4. PRESERVE every existing export name, the Area union, AREAS order, AREA_ORDER, UNASSIGNED_AREA — downstream components and useJobs depend on them. KEEP all existing CITY_AREA entries: they are deliberate business overrides, not redundancy.

file.case: Each settlement type resolves: city (חיפה→צפון), moshav (כפר תבור→צפון), kibbutz (ניר עם→דרום), community settlement (אלון שבות→ירושלים per override policy, else CBS district).
Override precedence: מודיעין → 'ירושלים' (CITY_AREA) even though CBS puts it in מחוז המרכז.
Normalization: 'פתח תקוה', ' פתח תקווה ', with geresh variants — all resolve to 'מרכז'.
Parity: normalizeCityName(runtime) output === generated keys for a sample of 20 raw source names.
Unknown settlement → UNASSIGNED_AREA; getSubArea returns undefined rather than throwing.
Sub-area sanity: תל אביב→'גוש דן', רעננה→'השרון', רחובות→'שפלה ומרכז'.

constraints.c: Follow CLAUDE.md: pnpm only, strict TS, path alias @/, RTL-safe UI (no change expected here), Hebrew UI text / English identifiers.
Area derives from settlement NAME only — never trust source-sheet region columns.
No runtime network calls for area resolution; no new runtime dependencies.
Do not touch useJobs hook ordering, JobsProvider, or Supabase sync (dbJobSync.ts).
Bundle budget: generated module ≤ ~80KB raw (~1,300 entries × 2 maps is well under; verify in build output).

acceptance_criteria.ac: pnpm lint and pnpm test pass; pnpm build succeeds.
pnpm generate:areas is idempotent: second run produces zero git diff.
Every settlement in the CBS snapshot resolves to exactly one Area; generation fails (non-zero exit) on ambiguity or unmapped district.
Spot-check 10 settlements spanning all five areas against real geography.
Manual QA: JobCategoryPage area sections render identically for existing customers (no regressions from normalization).

task.rollback: Single-commit revert restores prior behavior: CITY_AREA path is untouched, generated file is additive, and the fallback chain degrades to exactly the old lookup if the generated module is removed.
task.out_of_scope: UI for sub-areas (badges, within-area sorting), splitting 'מרכז' into separate scheduling zones, geocoding/coordinates enrichment. Each is a follow-up; the generator's mapping tables are the only touch-point.
